offers_products.reason: Sells advertising display time on billboards, transit and digital screens it owns; no goods or software are sold.

offers_services.reason: Out-of-home advertising services: campaign placement on billboards and transit media, creative studios, audience data and measurement.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers are advertisers and brands, plus agencies and political groups; the public only sees the ads.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Advertisers such as brands, agencies, and government and political bodies buy billboard and transit ad space.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes from time-limited ad campaigns, though advertisers often rebook. Mixed, leaning to campaign-based sales.

cyclical_demand.reason: Advertising budgets are among the first things businesses cut in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Campaigns are bought frequently as short flights of billboard or transit space, not as large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for access to its billboard, transit and digital display network, not mainly for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main advertisers are national brands and agencies, such as Sony, along with government and election bodies.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns and leases large networks of billboards, transit displays and digital screens, needing ongoing capital and lease commitments.

notes: Recurring revenue is a judgement call, since advertisers often rebook but campaigns are short.
